# DynamicCentralitySteering

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A control-theoretic framework for actively modulating the time-varying centrality of nodes in a network to achieve desired dynamical outcomes. Enables TCC/iNEST systems to adaptively reconfigure information flow and resource allocation in response to changing computational or neuromorphic demands.
